text:
Which change occurs in the nucleus of a radioactive atom during β-emission?
A
A neutron transforms into a proton and an electron.
B
A neutron transforms into a proton only.
C
A proton transforms into a neutron and an electron.
D
A proton transforms into a neutron only.

options.label: A
options.text: A neutron transforms into a proton and an electron.

options.label: B
options.text: A neutron transforms into a proton only.

options.label: C
options.text: A proton transforms into a neutron and an electron.

options.label: D
options.text: A proton transforms into a neutron only.
